checkuser-si-cases-link: Link text shown next to a user in the "Get users" results on [[Special:CheckUser]]. Shown when the user appears in at least one Suggested Investigations case. Links to [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] filtered to that user.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations: {{doc-special}}This page presents a list of accounts that triggered some signals and are brought to the attention of check users.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-abuse-:
Link text shown next to an account in a Suggested Investigations case, linking to Special:AbuseReview filtered by that account. Shown only when the account has AbuseReview hits. "AbuseReview hits" refers to edits automatically tagged for review.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of AbuseReview hits recorded for the account.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-autocl: Reason text stored on a Suggested Investigations case when it is automatically closed because all accounts in the case have been blocked or locked.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-date-c:
A line shown beneath the risk signal names in the Risk signals column of the Suggested investigations table, showing the timestamp the case was created.

Parameters:
* $1 - The formatted timestamp the case was created.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-detail:
{{doc-special}}This subpage of the {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations}} special page shows extended information about a given case.

Parameters:
* $1 - The case ID as a formatted number.
Used as a title on an error page when a user visits 'Special:SuggestedInvestigations/detail/X' where 'X' does not correspond to an existing case URL identifier.
Used as page text for an error page when a user visits 'Special:SuggestedInvestigations/detail/X' where 'X' does not correspond to an existing case URL identifier.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-subpag: Used as a title on an error page when a user visits 'Special:SuggestedInvestigations/X' where 'X' does not exist as a valid subpage.
Used as page text for an error page when a user visits 'Special:SuggestedInvestigations/X' where 'X' does not exist as a valid subpage.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-summar:
Introductory message shown on [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]].

See also:* {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-summary-detail-view}}

Introductory message shown on [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] when viewing detailed information about a specific suggested investigation.

Parameters:
* $1 - The ID number of the specific suggested investigation being viewed

See also:* {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-summary}}
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-privat: Message shown on [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] to warn users that the page shows private data and that sharing it widely should be avoided.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-filter: Used as a warning message displayed when the applied filters are too broad and the system has stopped searching for matching cases before finding the full page of results. Users can solve this by applying additional filters to narrow the number of cases that need to searched through. For example, if the {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-filter-dialog-edits-only-filter}} filter is applied and many cases are filtered out by the filter, then the user could see this warning.
Text used as the label of a button that opens a dialog used to filter cases shown on [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]]
Label for button used to close a dialog (without making any changes) that filters table rows in [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]].
Label for button used to revert changes in a dialog that filters table rows in [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]].
Label for button used to apply a new set of filters to the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] page.
Label for a set of checkboxes used to filter for cases that matched specific signals in the [[Special:SuggsetedInvestigations]] page.
Label for a set of checkboxes used to filter for cases with a specific status in the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] page.
Label for a set of checkboxes used to filter for cases with specific activity on the listed accounts in the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] page.
Label for a checkbox used to filter for cases where accounts have edited on the same page(s). Used in a filter dialog on the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] page.
Label for a set of radio inputs used to filter for cases with specific activity (edits and blocks) parameters on the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] page.

Label for a radio input that, when selected, filters for cases where there are any global edits and blocks on any of the involved accounts.

Similar to {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-filter-dialog-edits-and-blocks-filter}}.

Label for a radio input that, when selected, filters for cases where there are any edits and blocks on any of the involved accounts.

Similar to {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-filter-dialog-global-edits-and-blocks-filter}}.

Label for a radio input that, when selected, filters for cases where there are any global edits or blocks on any of the involved accounts.

Similar to {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-filter-dialog-edits-or-blocks-filter}}.

Label for a radio input that, when selected, filters for cases where there are any edits or blocks on any of the involved accounts.

Similar to {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-filter-dialog-global-edits-or-blocks-filter}}.

Label for a radio input that, when selected, filters for cases where there are any global edits from any of the involved accounts while ignoring block statuses.

Similar to {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-filter-dialog-edits-only-filter}}.

Label for a radio input that, when selected, filters for cases where there are any edits from any of the involved accountswhile ignoring block statuses.

Similar to {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-filter-dialog-global-edits-only-filter}}.
Label for a radio input that, when selected, filters for cases where there are any blocks on any of the involved accounts while ignoring edit counts.
Label for a radio input that, when selected, ignores all edit and block conditions for case filtering.
Label for a group of radio buttons used to filter cases by when they were last updated in the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] filter dialog.
Label for a radio button option that shows only cases updated today. Used in the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] filter dialog.
Label for a radio button option that shows only cases updated in the last 3 days. Used in the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] filter dialog.
Label for a radio button option that shows only cases updated in the last 7 days. Used in the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] filter dialog.
Label for a radio button option that shows only cases updated in the last 90 days. Used in the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] filter dialog.
Label for a radio button option (the default) that shows cases from all time, without any date restriction. Used in the [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] filter dialog.
Label for a input field that a user can type an account name into to filter cases on [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] to those with the given account in them.
Placeholder text for an input field used to filter for a specific username in [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]].
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-back-t: Subtitle link shown on the detail view of [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]] that is used to go back to the main view of the special page. Uses {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations}}.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-table-: Caption for the Suggested investigations table shown in the header of the table
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-header: Header of the column listing accounts to investigate in the Suggested investigations table
Header of the column listing signals that triggered the suggestion in the Suggested investigations table
Header of the column with the timestamp a case was last updated in the Suggested investigations table
Header of the column with investigation status in the Suggested investigations table
Header of the column with notes in the Suggested investigations table
Header of the column with actions in the Suggested investigations table
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-relate:
Shown in the metadata line of a Suggested Investigations case, indicating the number of other cases related to this one (same set of accounts and overlapping signals).

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of related cases.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-shared:
A line shown beneath the risk signal names in the Risk signals column of the Suggested investigations table, summarising the activity of a case's accounts on shared pages.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of edits made by the case's accounts on shared pages
* $2 - Number of shared pages, i.e. pages edited by at least two accounts in the case
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-revisi:
A line shown beneath the risk signal names in the Risk signals column of the Suggested investigations table that shows the number of reverted revisions compared to total revisions summed from all accounts in the case.

Parameters:
* $1 - Total number of reverted revisions across accounts in case
* $2 - Total number of revisions across accounts in case
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-revert:
A variant of {{msg-mw|contribslink}} used when the user has reverted revisions.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of reverted revisions
* $2 - Total number of revisions
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-delete:
A line shown beneath the risk signal names in the Risk signals column of the Suggested investigations table that shows the number of total deleted revisions summed from all accounts in the case.

Parameters:
* $1 - Total number of deleted revisions across accounts in case
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-view-c: Text of a link, shown beneath the risk signal names in the Risk signals column of the Suggested investigations table, that opens the detailed view for a single case.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-user:
{{optional}}This message is used to render items in the users column of the Suggested investigations table.

Parameters:
* $1 - Username, formatted as a link to the user page or contributions (for temp accounts)
* $2 - Tool links for that user wrapped in the {{msg-mw|parentheses}} message
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-user-c:
Text of a link shown next to usernames in the users column of the Suggested investigations table.

Parameters:
* $1 - Username of the associated user, for GENDER purposes.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-user-a:
Link text shown next to an account in a Suggested Investigations case, linking to Special:AbuseLog filtered by that account. Shown only when the account has AbuseFilter hits. "Filter hits" refers to triggering abuse filters by the user.

Parameters:
* $1 - the number of AbuseFilter hits recorded for the account.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-user-p:
Text of a link shown next to usernames in the users column of the Suggested investigations table.

Parameters:
* $1 - Username of the associated user, for GENDER purposes.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-user-s:
Link text shown next to an account in a Suggested Investigations case, linking to Special:SuggestedInvestigations filtered by that account.

Parameters:
* $1 - the total number of SI cases the account appears in.

Label of the button to show all the users in a suggestion. Note: this message uses PLURAL for languages that use dual or paucal forms. The singular will never be used here.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of additional users that are hidden. This will always be at least 2

Label of the button to hide users in the suggestion, who were shown by clicking {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-user-showmore}}. "Last" means at the bottom of the list, there's no ordering of accounts by their age etc. Note: this message uses PLURAL for languages that use dual or paucal forms. The singular will never be used here.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of users that will be hidden. This will always be at least 2
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-user-c:
Text used as the prefilled reason input box on Special:CheckUser when opening one of the check links for a case shown on Special:SuggestedInvestigations.

Parameters:
* $1 - The link to the suggested investigations case the user being checked is in
* $2 - The ID of the case the user being checked is in
* $3 - The username being checked, which can be used for GENDER support
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-user-i:
Text used as the prefilled reason input box on Special:Investigate when opening the investigate link for a case shown on Special:SuggestedInvestigations.

Parameters:
* $1 - The link to the suggested investigations case being investigated
* $3 - The ID of the case being investigated
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-status: Label that indicates that the suggested investigation is open. It's an adjective that describes "investigation", and should be consistent with the page title {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations}}.

Label that indicates that the suggested investigation has been resolved and is not a false positive. It's an adjective that describes "investigation", and should be consistent with the page title {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations}}.

Label that indicates that the suggested investigation was incorrect, which means the users didn't violate any rules. It's an adjective that describes "investigation", and should be consistent with the page title {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations}}.

Subtitle text shown to clarify the intended use of the Invalid status in the dialog used to change its state.

Uses {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-status-reason-default-invalid}}
Text used as the 'notes' for a suggested investigation when the user has selected the Invalid status but provided no associated note / reason for selecting that status.

{{optional}} Used to format the status reason cell when both a reason and a performer link are present. $1 is the formatted reason HTML, $2 is the performer link HTML. The order of $1 and $2 can be swapped for RTL languages.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-action: Label for a button that opens the [[Special:Investigate]] page for all users in the case

Label for a disabled button that would normally open the [[Special:Investigate]] page for all users in the case. The button is disabled because there are more users than the Investigate special page can handle at once.

Parameters:
* $1 - The maximum number of users that can be handled at once by the Investigate special page
Label for a button that opens [[Special:MultiLock]] for all visible accounts in a Suggested Investigations case.
Label for a button that opens a dialog to change the status of the case
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-change:
{{Identical|Close}}
Label used for a button that allows the suggested investigations change status dialog to be closed
Label for a button in the change status dialog for canceling the operation and closing the suggested investigations change status dialog.
Label for a button in the change status dialog for submitting the status change and closing the suggested investigations change status dialog.
Title shown in the change status dialog used to change the status of a given suggested investigation case.
Descriptive subtitle in shown the change status dialog used to change the status of a given suggested investigation case.
Header shown above the list of new states a given suggested investigation case can be updated to.
Header shown above the reason field used to describe why a given suggested investigations case has a status.
Description shown above the reason input when the selected status is 'resolved' in the suggested investigations change status dialog

Description shown above the reason input when the selected status is 'invalid' in the suggested investigations change status dialog. Refers to {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-status-reason-default-invalid}}.
Text used as the placeholder for the reason input when the selected status is 'resolved' in the suggested investigations change status dialog
Text used as the placeholder for the reason input when the selected status is 'invalid' in the suggested investigations change status dialog
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-risk-s: Introduction of the body text of a popover shown to describe more information about risk signals shown in Special:SuggestedInvestigations

{{Identical|Close}}
Label used on the close button in a popover shown to describe more information about risk signals shown in Special:SuggestedInvestigations
Label used on the open button in a popover shown to describe more information about risk signals shown in Special:SuggestedInvestigations
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-detail:
Header shown above a list of edits associated with a risk signal in the Special:SuggestedInvestigations details view.

Parameters:
* $1 - The name of the risk signal that is associated with the edits (one of the [[Special:PrefixIndex/MediaWiki:Checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-signal|messages that start with ‘checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-signal’]]).
* $2 - The number of edits that are being displayed.

Header shown above a list of log entries associated with a risk signal in the Special:SuggestedInvestigations details view.

Parameters:
* $1 - The name of the risk signal that is associated with the edits (one of the [[Special:PrefixIndex/MediaWiki:Checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-signal|messages that start with ‘checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-signal’]]).
* $2 - The number of log entries that are being displayed.

Header shown above the list of edits made by a case's accounts on "shared" pages (pages edited by at least two accounts in the case) in the Special:SuggestedInvestigations details view.

Parameters:
* $1 - The total number of edits made by the case's accounts on shared pages.

Sub-header shown above the list of deleted edits made by a case's accounts on "shared" pages, within the shared-pages section of the Special:SuggestedInvestigations details view. Only shown to users who can view deleted edits.

Parameters:
* $1 - The number of deleted edits being displayed.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-contri:
Used as text for a link to [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]]. Shown in [[Special:Contributions]] for an existing username when that user is present in at least one suggested investigations case. Only seen by users who can view the suggested investigations page.

The phrase 'SI' is an abbreviation of 'Suggested Investigations' and is used to save space, but can be expanded if an abbreviation would not work in your language.
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-invali: Text of a warning message shown when a user selects the {{msg-mw|checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-status-invalid}} status indicating that if the case is closed as invalid no future cases will be created for this account for the signals in the case.
checkuser-si-related-cases-info:
Notice shown on Special:Block when the block target is associated with any suggested investigations cases and the performer has access to suggested investigations.

Parameters:
* $1 - Number of related accounts
* $2 - Number of suggested investigations cases
* $3 - Username of the block target
checkuser-suggestedinvestigations-queue-: Label for a button in a toggle button group on Special:SuggestedInvestigations. It describes a 'queue', which is a set of filters applied to the cases shown.

Label for a button in a toggle button group on Special:SuggestedInvestigations. It describes a 'queue', which is a set of filters applied to the cases shown. This is used if the view has been edited from the default queue view.
Title of a dialog used to filter the table rows shown on [[Special:SuggestedInvestigations]].
